bio.text: John Peterson is the Republican candidate in South Carolina's 6th Congressional District, a seat held by Democratic Rep. Jim Clyburn for 33 years.
WCSC reported that Peterson is a former mathematician who works at the North Charleston Convention Center.
Peterson told WCSC that he has volunteered for Donald Trump's campaigns, including canvassing in North Carolina.

sources.title: We The Palmetto: Peterson challenges Clyburn
